title: Facile synthesis of CoFe2O4@SiO2 nanoparticles anchored on reduced graphene oxide for highly efficient electromagnetic wave absorption
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25872-25884
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03579A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hechao Lu, Chenyu Li, Kaiwen Chen, Qinting He, Fang Ren, Juan Wu, Renxing Dai
In this study, a ternary composite material composed of CoFe2O4@SiO2 nanospheres and reduced graphene oxide (RGO) was successfully synthesized through a facile route.
